correction_rationale.URI: CESU-8 encodes surrogate code points, which URI decoding must reject even when they form a UTF-16 pair. Proper four-byte UTF-8 remains accepted.
correction_rationale.JSON: 262144 is the dense growth threshold, not a universal logical array-length bound. Preserve crossing behavior and distinct duplicate-key semantics; additionally assert the actual parser-wide 4194304-element budget using repeated duplicate-key arrays to keep live storage small.
correction_rationale.strings: The current construction guard is 67108864 UTF-16 code units, not the stale 16777216 expectation. Replacement and joining exceed the actual guard by one ASCII code unit. Unexpected success returns a boolean rather than a huge string.
correction_rationale.shared_graph: 65 references to an array containing a shared 1 MiB string exceed the 64 MiB output guard with little traversal work, retaining amplification coverage without the former millions of numeric conversions and timeout.
correction_rationale.catalog: Selected cases run under Node subprocess isolation with expected-verdict checks. Materialization rejects toSorted length262145; large indexed assignment preserves sparse logical length; no unbounded array OOM workload is executed.
